verses.he: וְזֶ֨ה הַדָּבָ֜ר אֲשֶֽׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֑י לְ֠קַח פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֧ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר וְאֵילִ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.ar: «وَهَذَا مَا تَصْنَعُهُ لَهُمْ لِتَقْدِيسِهِمْ لِيَكْهَنُوا لِي: خُذْ ثَوْرًا وَاحِدًا ٱبْنَ بَقَرٍ، وَكَبْشَيْنِ صَحِيحَيْنِ،
verses.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto Me in the priest's office: take one young bullock and two rams without blemish,
verses.kjv: And this [is] the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
verses.web: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

verses.he: וְלֶ֣חֶם מַצֹּ֗ות וְחַלֹּ֤ת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצֹּ֖ות מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן סֹ֥לֶת חִטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَخُبْزَ فَطِيرٍ، وَأَقْرَاصَ فَطِيرٍ مَلْتُوتَةً بِزَيْتٍ، وَرُقَاقَ فَطِيرٍ مَدْهُونَةً بِزَيْتٍ. مِنْ دَقِيقِ حِنْطَةٍ تَصْنَعُهَا.
verses.en: and unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened mingled with oil, and wafers unleavened spread with oil; of fine wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.kjv: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: [of] wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.web: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

verses.he: וְנָתַתָּ֤ אֹותָם֙ עַל־סַ֣ל אֶחָ֔ד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּסָּ֑ל וְאֶ֨ת־הַפָּ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֵילִֽם׃
verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُهَا فِي سَلَّةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، وَتُقَدِّمُهَا فِي ٱلسَّلَّةِ مَعَ ٱلثَّوْرِ وَٱلْكَبْشَيْنِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.web: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

verses.he: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו֙ תַּקְרִ֔יב אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.ar: «وَتُقَدِّمُ هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ إِلَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ وَتَغْسِلُهُمْ بِمَاءٍ.
verses.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tent of meeting, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.kjv: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.web: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

verses.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִ֗ים וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־הַכֻּתֹּ֔נֶת וְאֵת֙ מְעִ֣יל הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְאֶת־הָאֵפֹ֖ד וְאֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וְאָפַדְתָּ֣ לֹ֔ו בְּחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃
verses.ar: وَتَأْخُذُ ٱلثِّيَابَ وَتُلْبِسُ هَارُونَ ٱلْقَمِيصَ وَجُبَّةَ ٱلرِّدَاءِ وَٱلرِّدَاءَ وَٱلصُّدْرَةَ، وَتَشُدُّهُ بِزُنَّارِ ٱلرِّدَاءِ،
verses.en: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the tunic, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
verses.web: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

verses.he: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל־רֹאשֹׁ֑ו וְנָתַתָּ֛ אֶת־נֵ֥זֶר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַל־הַמִּצְנָֽפֶת׃
verses.ar: وَتَضَعُ ٱلْعِمَامَةَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، وَتَجْعَلُ ٱلْإِكْلِيلَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَ عَلَى ٱلْعِمَامَةِ،
verses.en: And thou shalt set the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.web: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

verses.he: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְיָצַקְתָּ֖ עַל־רֹאשֹׁ֑ו וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֖ אֹתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: وَتَأْخُذُ دُهْنَ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَتَسْكُبُهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَتَمْسَحُهُ.
verses.en: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour [it] upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.web: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

verses.he: וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃
verses.ar: وَتُقَدِّمُ بَنِيهِ وَتُلْبِسُهُمْ أَقْمِصَةً.
verses.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put tunics upon them.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
verses.web: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

verses.he: וְחָגַרְתָּ֩ אֹתָ֨ם אַבְנֵ֜ט אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ֤ לָהֶם֙ מִגְבָּעֹ֔ת וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם כְּהֻנָּ֖ה לְחֻקַּ֣ת עֹולָ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ יֽ͏ַד־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְיַד־בָּנָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَتُنَطِّقُهُمْ بِمَنَاطِقَ، هَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ، وَتَشُدُّ لَهُمْ قَلَانِسَ. فَيَكُونُ لَهُمْ كَهَنُوتٌ فَرِيضَةً أَبَدِيَّةً. وَتَمْلَأُ يَدَ هَارُونَ وَأَيْدِيَ بَنِيهِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and bind head-tires on them; and they shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute; and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.web: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

verses.he: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַפָּ֔ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּֽר׃
verses.ar: «وَتُقَدِّمُ ٱلثَّوْرَ إِلَى قُدَّامِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، فَيَضَعُ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلثَّوْرِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt bring the bullock before the tent of meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.web: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

verses.he: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: فَتَذْبَحُ ٱلثَّوْرَ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ عِنْدَ بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, [by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: You shall kill the bull before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל־קַרְנֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶת־כָּל־הַדָּ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־יְסֹ֖וד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.ar: وَتَأْخُذُ مِنْ دَمِ ٱلثَّوْرِ وَتَجْعَلُهُ عَلَى قُرُونِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ بِإِصْبِعِكَ، وَسَائِرَ ٱلدَّمِ تَصُبُّهُ إِلَى أَسْفَلِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger; and thou shalt pour out all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
verses.web: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

verses.he: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֗ אֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵ֗ת הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ן וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֖ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.ar: وَتَأْخُذُ كُلَّ ٱلشَّحْمِ ٱلَّذِي يُغَشِّي ٱلْجَوْفَ، وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِمَا، وَتُوقِدُهَا عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the lobe above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and make them smoke upon the altar.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul [that is] above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, and burn [them] upon the altar.
verses.web: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

verses.he: וְאֶת־בְּשַׂ֤ר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־עֹרֹ֣ו וְאֶת־פִּרְשֹׁ֔ו תִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا لَحْمُ ٱلثَّوْرِ وَجِلْدُهُ وَفَرْثُهُ فَتَحْرِقُهَا بِنَارٍ خَارِجَ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ. هُوَ ذَبِيحَةُ خَطِيَّةٍ.
verses.en: But the flesh of the bullock, and its skin, and its dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp; it is a sin-offering.
verses.kjv: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it [is] a sin offering.
verses.web: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

verses.he: וְאֶת־הָאַ֥יִל הָאֶחָ֖ד תִּקָּ֑ח וְסָ֨מְכ֜וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
verses.ar: «وَتَأْخُذُ ٱلْكَبْشَ ٱلْوَاحِدَ، فَيَضَعُ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْكَبْشِ.
verses.en: Thou shalt also take the one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.web: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.he: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֖ אֶת־הָאָ֑יִל וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־דָּמֹ֔ו וְזָרַקְתָּ֥ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: فَتَذْبَحُ ٱلْكَبْشَ وَتَأْخُذُ دَمَهُ وَتَرُشُّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مِنْ كُلِّ نَاحِيَةٍ.
verses.en: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take its blood, and dash it round about against the altar.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle [it] round about upon the altar.
verses.web: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

verses.he: וְאֶ֨ת־הָאַ֔יִל תְּנַתֵּ֖חַ לִנְתָחָ֑יו וְרָחַצְתָּ֤ קִרְבֹּו֙ וּכְרָעָ֔יו וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־נְתָחָ֖יו וְעַל־רֹאשֹֽׁו׃
verses.ar: وَتَقْطَعُ ٱلْكَبْشَ إِلَى قِطَعِهِ، وَتَغْسِلُ جَوْفَهُ وَأَكَارِعَهُ وَتَجْعَلُهَا عَلَى قِطَعِهِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ،
verses.en: And thou shalt cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its inwards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put [them] unto his pieces, and unto his head.
verses.web: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

verses.he: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֤ אֶת־כָּל־הָאַ֙יִל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֥ה ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָ֑ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔וחַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَتُوقِدُ كُلَّ ٱلْكَبْشِ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ. هُوَ مُحْرَقَةٌ لِلرَّبِّ. رَائِحَةُ سَرُورٍ، وَقُودٌ هُوَ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And thou shalt make the whole ram smoke upon the altar; it is a burnt-offering unto the LORD; it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it [is] a burnt offering unto the LORD: it [is] a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.web: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to Yahweh; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
verses.ar: «وَتَأْخُذُ ٱلْكَبْشَ ٱلثَّانِي، فَيَضَعُ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْكَبْشِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.web: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.he: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־הָאַ֗יִל וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ מִדָּמֹו֙ וְנָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל־תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְעַל־תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָיו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְזָרַקְתָּ֧ אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: فَتَذْبَحُ ٱلْكَبْشَ وَتَأْخُذُ مِنْ دَمِهِ وَتَجْعَلُ عَلَى شَحْمَةِ أُذُنِ هَارُونَ، وَعَلَى شَحْمِ آذَانِ بَنِيهِ ٱلْيُمْنَى، وَعَلَى أَبَاهِمِ أَيْدِيهِمِ ٱلْيُمْنَى، وَعَلَى أَبَاهِمِ أَرْجُلِهِمِ ٱلْيُمْنَى. وَتَرُشُّ ٱلدَّمَ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مِنْ كُلِّ نَاحِيَةٍ.
verses.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of its blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and dash the blood against the altar round about.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put [it] upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.web: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

verses.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן־הַדָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֮ וּמִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֒ וְהִזֵּיתָ֤ עַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְעַל־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתֹּ֑ו וְקָדַ֥שׁ הוּא֙ וּבְגָדָ֔יו וּבָנָ֛יו וּבִגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: وَتَأْخُذُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ وَمِنْ دُهْنِ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ، وَتَنْضِحُ عَلَى هَارُونَ وَثِيَابِهِ، وَعَلَى بَنِيهِ وَثِيَابِ بَنِيهِ مَعَهُ، فَيَتَقَدَّسُ هُوَ وَثِيَابُهُ وَبَنُوهُ وَثِيَابُ بَنِيهِ مَعَهُ.
verses.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him; and he and his garments shall be hallowed, and his sons and his sons' garments with him.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood that [is] upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle [it] upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.web: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן־הָ֠אַיִל הַחֵ֨לֶב וְהָֽאַלְיָ֜ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב ׀ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֗רֶב וְאֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַכָּבֵד֙ וְאֵ֣ת ׀ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֗ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת שֹׁ֣וק הַיָּמִ֑ין כִּ֛י אֵ֥יל מִלֻּאִ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ مِنَ ٱلْكَبْشِ: ٱلشَّحْمَ وَٱلْإِلْيَةَ وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي يُغَشِّي ٱلْجَوْفَ، وَزِيَادَةَ ٱلْكَبِدِ وَٱلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ، وَٱلشَّحْمَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَيْهِمَا، وَٱلسَّاقَ ٱلْيُمْنَى. فَإِنَّهُ كَبْشُ مِلْءٍ.
verses.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right thigh; for it is a ram of consecration;
verses.kjv: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul [above] the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, and the right shoulder; for it [is] a ram of consecration:
verses.web: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

verses.he: וְכִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וַֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד מִסַּל֙ הַמַּצֹּ֔ות אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَرَغِيفًا وَاحِدًا مِنَ ٱلْخُبْزِ، وَقُرْصًا وَاحِدًا مِنَ ٱلْخُبْزِ بِزَيْتٍ، وَرُقَاقَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْ سَلَّةِ ٱلْفَطِيرِ ٱلَّتِي أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
verses.kjv: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that [is] before the LORD:
verses.web: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.

verses.he: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَتَضَعُ ٱلْجَمِيعَ فِي يَدَيْ هَارُونَ وَفِي أَيْدِي بَنِيهِ، وَتُرَدِّدُهَا تَرْدِيدًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And thou shalt put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave-offering before the LORD.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them [for] a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.web: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

verses.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֥ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־הָעֹלָ֑ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙וחַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُهَا مِنْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتُوقِدُهَا عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ فَوْقَ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ رَائِحَةَ سَرُورٍ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ. وَقُودٌ هُوَ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And thou shalt take them from their hands, and make them smoke on the altar upon the burnt-offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD; it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn [them] upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it [is] an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.web: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הֶֽחָזֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֤יל הַמִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתֹ֛ו תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמָנָֽה׃
verses.ar: «ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ ٱلْقَصَّ مِنْ كَبْشِ ٱلْمِلْءِ ٱلَّذِي لِهَارُونَ، وَتُرَدِّدُهُ تَرْدِيدًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، فَيَكُونُ لَكَ نَصِيبًا.
verses.en: And thou shalt take the breast of Aaron's ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave-offering before the LORD; and it shall be thy portion.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it [for] a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
verses.web: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.

verses.he: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת ׀ חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ שֹׁ֣וק הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּנַ֖ף וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּרָ֑ם מֵאֵיל֙ הַמִּלֻּאִ֔ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְבָנָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَتُقَدِّسُ قَصَّ ٱلتَّرْدِيدِ وَسَاقَ ٱلرَّفِيعَةِ ٱلَّذِي رُدِّدَ وَٱلَّذِي رُفِعَ مِنْ كَبْشِ ٱلْمِلْءِ مِمَّا لِهَارُونَ وَلِبَنِيهِ،
verses.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave-offering, and the thigh of the heave-offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is Aaron's, and of that which is his sons'.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, [even] of [that] which [is] for Aaron, and of [that] which is for his sons:
verses.web: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

verses.he: וְהָיָה֩ לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּלְבָנָ֜יו לְחָק־עֹולָ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תְרוּמָ֖ה ה֑וּא וּתְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵאֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִזִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֔ם תְּרוּמָתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَيَكُونَانِ لِهَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ فَرِيضَةً أَبَدِيَّةً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ لِأَنَّهُمَا رَفِيعَةٌ. وَيَكُونَانِ رَفِيعَةً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ ذَبَائِحِ سَلَامَتِهِمْ، رَفِيعَتَهُمْ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons as a due for ever from the children of Israel; for it is a heave-offering; and it shall be a heave-offering from the children of Israel of their sacrifices of peace-offerings, even their heave-offering unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it [is] an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, [even] their heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.web: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.

verses.he: וּבִגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן יִהְי֥וּ לְבָנָ֖יו אַחֲרָ֑יו לְמָשְׁחָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם וּלְמַלֵּא־בָ֖ם אֶת־יָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: «وَٱلثِّيَابُ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةُ ٱلَّتِي لِهَارُونَ تَكُونُ لِبَنِيهِ بَعْدَهُ، لِيُمْسَحُوا فِيهَا، وَلِتُمْلَأَ فِيهَا أَيْدِيهِمْ.
verses.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.web: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

verses.he: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִלְבָּשָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תַּחְתָּ֖יו מִבָּנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֛א אֶל־אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֥ת בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ يَلْبَسُهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ عِوَضٌ عَنْهُ مِنْ بَنِيهِ، ٱلَّذِي يَدْخُلُ خَيْمَةَ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ لِيَخْدِمَ فِي ٱلْقُدْسِ.
verses.en: Seven days shall the son that is priest in his stead put them on, even he who cometh into the tent of meeting to minister in the holy place.
verses.kjv: [And] that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy [place].
verses.web: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

verses.he: וְאֵ֛ת אֵ֥יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֖ים תִּקָּ֑ח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֥ אֶת־בְּשָׂרֹ֖ו בְּמָקֹ֥ם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
verses.ar: «وَأَمَّا كَبْشُ ٱلْمِلْءِ فَتَأْخُذُهُ وَتَطْبُخُ لَحْمَهُ فِي مَكَانٍ مُقَدَّسٍ.
verses.en: And thou shalt take the ram of consecration, and seethe its flesh in a holy place.
verses.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
verses.web: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

verses.he: וְאָכַ֨ל אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר הָאַ֔יִל וְאֶת־הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסָּ֑ל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: فَيَأْكُلُ هَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ لَحْمَ ٱلْكَبْشِ وَٱلْخُبْزَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّلَّةِ عِنْدَ بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that [is] in the basket, [by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְאָכְל֤וּ אֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֻּפַּ֣ר בָּהֶ֔ם לְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־יָדָ֖ם לְקַדֵּ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑ם וְזָ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכַ֖ל כִּי־קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֵֽם׃
verses.ar: يَأْكُلُهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُفِّرَ بِهَا عَنْهُمْ لِمِلْءِ أَيْدِيهِمْ لِتَقْدِيسِهِمْ. وَأَمَّا ٱلْأَجْنَبِيُّ فَلَا يَأْكُلُ لِأَنَّهَا مُقَدَّسَةٌ.
verses.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
verses.kjv: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate [and] to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat [thereof], because they [are] holy.
verses.web: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

verses.he: וְֽאִם־יִוָּתֵ֞ר מִבְּשַׂ֧ר הַמִּלֻּאִ֛ים וּמִן־הַלֶּ֖חֶם עַד־הַבֹּ֑קֶר וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֤ אֶת־הַנֹּותָר֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל כִּי־קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ بَقِيَ شَيْءٌ مِنْ لَحْمِ ٱلْمِلْءِ أَوْ مِنَ ٱلْخُبْزِ إِلَى ٱلصَّبَاحِ، تُحْرِقُ ٱلْبَاقِيَ بِٱلنَّارِ. لَا يُؤْكَلُ لِأَنَّهُ مُقَدَّسٌ.
verses.en: And if aught of the flesh of the consecration, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.kjv: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it [is] holy.
verses.web: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לְאַהֲרֹ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ כָּ֔כָה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּ֖יתִי אֹתָ֑כָה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תְּמַלֵּ֥א יָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ لِهَارُونَ وَبَنِيهِ هَكَذَا بِحَسَبِ كُلِّ مَا أَمَرْتُكَ. سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ تَمْلَأُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ.
verses.en: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee; seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all [things] which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.web: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

verses.he: וּפַ֨ר חַטָּ֜את תַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה לַיֹּום֙ עַל־הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּכַפֶּרְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו וּמָֽשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹתֹ֖ו לְקַדְּשֹֽׁו׃
verses.ar: وَتُقَدِّمُ ثَوْرَ خَطِيَّةٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ لِأَجْلِ ٱلْكَفَّارَةِ. وَتُطَهِّرُ ٱلْمَذْبَحَ بِتَكْفِيرِكَ عَلَيْهِ، وَتَمْسَحُهُ لِتَقْدِيسِهِ.
verses.en: And every day shalt thou offer the bullock of sin-offering, beside the other offerings of atonement; and thou shalt do the purification upon the altar when thou makest atonement for it; and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock [for] a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.web: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

verses.he: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֹ֑ו וְהָיָ֤ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בַּמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃ ס
verses.ar: سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ تُكَفِّرُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ وَتُقَدِّسُهُ، فَيَكُونُ ٱلْمَذْبَحُ قُدْسَ أَقْدَاسٍ. كُلُّ مَا مَسَّ ٱلْمَذْبَحَ يَكُونُ مُقَدَّسًا.
verses.en: Seven days thou shalt make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; thus shall the altar be most holy; whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.kjv: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.web: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

verses.he: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיֹּ֖ום תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.ar: «وَهَذَا مَا تُقَدِّمُهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ: خَرُوفَانِ حَوْلِيَّانِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ دَائِمًا.
verses.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar: two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.kjv: ¶ Now this [is that] which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.web: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

verses.he: אֶת־הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃
verses.ar: ٱلْخَرُوفُ ٱلْوَاحِدُ تُقَدِّمُهُ صَبَاحًا، وَٱلْخَرُوفُ ٱلثَّانِي تُقَدِّمُهُ فِي ٱلْعَشِيَّةِ.
verses.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at dusk.
verses.kjv: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
verses.web: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

verses.he: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּשֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַהִ֔ין וְנֵ֕סֶךְ רְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין יָ֑יִן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.ar: وَعُشْرٌ مِنْ دَقِيقٍ مَلْتُوتٍ بِرُبْعِ ٱلْهِينِ مِنْ زَيْتِ ٱلرَّضِّ، وَسَكِيبٌ رُبْعُ ٱلْهِينِ مِنَ ٱلْخَمْرِ لِلْخَرُوفِ ٱلْوَاحِدِ.
verses.en: And with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink-offering.
verses.kjv: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine [for] a drink offering.
verses.web: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

verses.he: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכָּהּ֙ תּֽ͏ַעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֔הּ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْخَرُوفُ ٱلثَّانِي تُقَدِّمُهُ فِي ٱلْعَشِيَّةِ. مِثْلَ تَقْدِمَةِ ٱلصَّبَاحِ وَسَكِيبِهِ تَصْنَعُ لَهُ. رَائِحَةُ سَرُورٍ، وَقُودٌ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at dusk, and shalt do thereto according to the meal-offering of the morning, and according to the drink-offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.web: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

verses.he: עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מֹועֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִוָּעֵ֤ד לָכֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה לְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: مُحْرَقَةٌ دَائِمَةٌ فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ عِنْدَ بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، حَيْثُ أَجْتَمِعُ بِكُمْ لِأُكَلِّمَكَ هُنَاكَ.
verses.en: It shall be a continual burnt-offering throughout your generations at the door of the tent of meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.kjv: [This shall be] a continual burnt offering throughout your generations [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.web: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

verses.he: וְנֹעַדְתִּ֥י שָׁ֖מָּה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנִקְדַּ֖שׁ בִּכְבֹדִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَأَجْتَمِعُ هُنَاكَ بِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَيُقَدَّسُ بِمَجْدِي.
verses.en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel; and the Tent shall be sanctified by My glory.
verses.kjv: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and [the tabernacle] shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.web: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

verses.he: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵ֖ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֧ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֛יו אֲקַדֵּ֖שׁ לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَأُقَدِّسُ خَيْمَةَ الِٱجْتِمَاعِ وَٱلْمَذْبَحَ، وَهَارُونُ وَبَنُوهُ أُقَدِّسُهُمْ لِكَيْ يَكْهَنُوا لِي.
verses.en: And I will sanctify the tent of meeting, and the altar; Aaron also and his sons will I sanctify, to minister to Me in the priest's office.
verses.kjv: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.web: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

verses.he: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּתֹ֖וךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَأَسْكُنُ فِي وَسَطِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَأَكُونُ لَهُمْ إِلَهًا،
verses.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.kjv: ¶ And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.web: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

verses.he: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹוצֵ֧אתִי אֹתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְשָׁכְנִ֣י בְתֹוכָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ פ
verses.ar: فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُهُمُ ٱلَّذِي أَخْرَجَهُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ لِأَسْكُنَ فِي وَسْطِهِمْ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُهُمْ.
verses.en: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
verses.kjv: And they shall know that I [am] the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I [am] the LORD their God.
verses.web: They shall know that I am Yahweh their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am Yahweh their God.
